title: The AI Skills Lab Podcast, with Future State University
author: Future State University
description:
Welcome to The AI Skills Lab, where we explore the future of learning, work, and human capability in the age of artificial intelligence.

The world of work is undergoing its most dramatic transformation in a century. AI isn't just changing what we do—it's fundamentally reshaping how we learn, how we demonstrate capability, and how we prepare for careers that don't yet exist. Traditional credentials are losing their predictive power. Employers can no longer trust that degrees and certifications translate into actual performance. Meanwhile, workers are stuck in a broken system where passive courses promise transformation but deliver forgettable content and single-digit completion rates.

The AI Skills Lab takes you inside the revolution happening at the intersection of immersive learning, artificial intelligence, and workforce development. Hosted by the team at Future State University—the world's first AI-native learning ecosystem—each episode investigates the critical questions facing educators, employers, and learners navigating this new landscape.

What makes durable skills actually durable? Why do credentials fail to predict performance? What's the difference between workers who use AI as a tool versus those trained in AI-native learning environments? And how can immersive 3D career simulations build verified capabilities at scale?

We go deep on the science of skill acquisition, the economics of talent development, and the technology making it possible to turn knowledge into applied performance. You'll hear from learning scientists, workforce strategists, technology pioneers, and practitioners building the future of human capability development.

This isn't a podcast about distant futures or abstract possibilities. Every episode explores real problems facing organizations today: the capability gap between what credentials signal and what performance requires, the transfer problem that makes most training fail, the explosion of micro-credentials that create more noise than signal, and the urgent need for learning systems that produce verified outcomes instead of vanity metrics.

Whether you're an HR leader rethinking talent development strategy, an educator questioning traditional pedagogy, a professional navigating career transitions in an AI-accelerated economy, or simply someone curious about how humans learn and grow—The AI Skills Lab gives you frameworks, evidence, and insights you can actually use.

We believe the future belongs to those who can demonstrate capability, not just claim it. To learners who practice deliberately in immersive environments, not passively consume content. To institutions that verify performance, not just award credentials. And to organizations that build skills that matter, not just check compliance boxes.

Join us in The AI Skills Lab, where theory meets practice, credentials give way to competencies, and the next generation of learning is being built in real time.

New episodes weekly. Subscribe wherever you listen to podcasts.

description:
HarinGay Radio is a four-part podcast and soundscape amplifying queer voices, histories and communities from the north London borough of Haringey.



Inspired by the radical traditions of community radio and pirate broadcasting, the series brings together voices from across the borough through workshops, conversations and recordings with local residents, artists, activists, historians and community leaders. Blending interviews, field recordings and shared memories, HarinGay Radio creates a vibrant sound portrait of Haringey’s queer past and present.



Across four episodes, contributors explore stories that span generations—from growing up Black and gay in Finsbury Park, to women’s football, the impact of Section 28 and the energy of contemporary queer nightlife, including Tottenham’s Uhaul Dyke Rescue club nights. Drawing on Bruce Castle Museum’s collections, including the landmark children’s book Jenny Lives with Eric and Martin, the series uncovers the people, places and moments that have shaped Haringey’s significant role in LGBTQ+ history.



Part oral history, part soundscape, part community broadcast, HarinGay Radio celebrates the creativity, resilience and activism of Haringey’s LGBTQ+ communities while preserving their stories for the future.


Created by artist Ian Giles in partnership with the Haringey LGBTQ+ Community Network and supported by Mind.


Edited by Ian Giles - with music by Phil Cornett, Sophie Crawford and Ali Wagner & Marie

title: The Podcast Effect
author: Ellen Ronalds Keene for PERK Digital
description:
What can a podcast actually do?
The Podcast Effect explores what happens when experts, organisations and ideas are given the space to be heard.
I'm Ellen Ronalds Keene, a podcast strategist, producer, educator and podcast super-listener. Through my business, PERK Digital, I've spent almost a decade producing, editing, launching and obsessing over podcasts.
And I genuinely love the audio medium. Podcasts have changed my own life since I started listening to them on my laptop in 2007. Since then, I've watched the medium grow and change, and I've become increasingly interested in what happens because a podcast exists.
The conversations it starts. The knowledge it captures. The relationships it builds. The people it reaches. The opportunities it creates.
Because podcasting offers something increasingly valuable: space, intimacy and trust.
Used deliberately, a podcast can publish expertise, build authority, preserve valuable knowledge and stories, deepen relationships and create enduring content that keeps working long after you hit publish.
In The Podcast Effect, we'll explore the strategy, economics and possibilities of podcasting — from audio versus video and the changing world of search and AI, to deep niche audiences, regional storytelling, enduring content and what meaningful podcast success actually looks like.
You'll hear solo episodes unpacking my frameworks and philosophy, alongside conversations with podcasters, producers, industry experts and people using podcasts to do genuinely interesting and valuable work.
Because your best ideas deserve more than a post or a 60-second reel.
They deserve a longer shelf life.
And a podcast doesn't need millions of listeners to make an impact. Sometimes 100 of the right listeners are more valuable than 100,000 who aren't the right audience for what you're trying to achieve.
This is The Podcast Effect.

On April 27, 2024, 30-year-old Mica Francis Miller — wife of Myrtle Beach pastor John-Paul Miller — walked a mile into a North Carolina state park and made a 911 call that would be the last time the world heard her voice. Within days, her death was ruled a suicide — a ruling that would have ended the story for most true crime journalists.

We aren't most true crime journalists. And Mica's story is anything but typical.


COERCED: The Devotion & Death of Mica Francis Miller is a LUNASHARK® DROP-FEED from the award-winning team behind the Murdaugh Murders Podcast — investigative journalists Mandy Matney, Liz Farrell and Beth Braden — along with producers Kate Thomas, Grace Hills and David Moses. It’s a remastered, chronological retelling of more than 2 years of original reporting from the True Sunlight Podcast, built for listeners who want to follow one case.

Listen To Current Coverage On The True Sunlight Podcast or⁠ ⁠Ad-Free from LUNASHARK Premium on Patreon or Supercast⁠⁠ 


At the time of her death, Mica left behind a paper trail of evidence documenting how JP allegedly abused Mica emotionally, physically, sexually, medically and spiritually throughout their relationship, which started when she was a teenager and he was her youth pastor. Mica died while she was in the process of divorcing JP Miller.


COERCED takes a deeper look at JP Miller’s dark past that includes rape allegations, alleged bestiality, an assault conviction and pardon, and a pattern of allegedly abusive behavior that can be traced back to his father — Rev. Wayne Miller. JP’s felon father once owned a Christian complex in South Carolina called Gloryland… before it mysteriously burned down.  


Through exclusive interviews, 911 calls, court filings, and documents obtained through relentless FOIA requests, COERCED examines coercive control, medical and spiritual abuse, and the systems that dismissed a woman fighting for her life — and asks what accountability looks like.


Mica couldn't save herself. But her story could save others.


This series discusses domestic abuse, coercive control, and suicide. If you or someone you know needs support, please call or text 988 or contact the National Domestic Violence Hotline at 1-800-799-7233. Support in South Carolina is also available through Liza’s Lifeline.

title: Ye of Little Faith: The Nature of Reality
author: Rog Phillips
description:
When Dr. Alan Sturgess, a brilliant physicist, stumbles upon a phenomenon that defies the very laws of nature, his life spirals into a whirlwind of doubt and intrigue. In "Ye of Little Faith," Rog Phillips takes listeners on a mind-bending journey through a reality where belief shapes existence. As Sturgess grapples with the implications of his discovery, he faces a chilling choice: embrace the unfathomable truths of the universe or cling to the comforting boundaries of logic.

This audiobook delves deep into the conflict between faith and reason, challenging listeners to ponder what lies beyond the tangible world. As strange occurrences unfold around him, Sturgess encounters a cast of characters who each embody different philosophies toward belief. Will he find allies in his search for understanding, or will skepticism lead him to isolation?

From the moment he uncovers the unexplainable, the stakes rise. Each twist and turn invites listeners to question their own perspectives on reality. Packed with rich ideas and philosophical dilemmas, "Ye of Little Faith" explores the nature of existence and the power of belief in a way that resonates long after the final chapter.

Join Dr. Sturgess as he embarks on a quest that merges science fiction with profound existential questions. Discover how the universe bends and twists around faith, and why sometimes, believing is the first step to uncovering the truth.

description:
When the mysterious Stranger offers a perilous challenge, the stakes are higher than anyone could imagine—one wrong step means a service to Satan, but four right steps could unlock unimaginable wealth. In "Seven Footprints to Satan," author Abraham Merritt takes listeners on a thrilling journey where every decision can lead to salvation or doom. Explore the dark underbelly of temptation as characters grapple with their deepest fears and desires, navigating a labyrinthine path filled with sinister secrets.

This action-packed adventure follows a group of daring souls who must confront the ultimate moral dilemma: will they risk everything for power, or choose the safer, but less rewarding, path? As they inch closer to Satan's black throne, the tension mounts, and alliances are tested. Who can be trusted, and who will betray them when faced with the lure of eternal servitude?

There are places where the common world wears thin.

In The Arthur Machen Library, the strange and visionary works of Arthur Machen are read in full: tales of ancient powers, hidden rites, haunted landscapes, forbidden knowledge, and the terrible beauty that lies just beyond ordinary sight.

Enter old woods, forgotten streets, lonely hills and secret chambers, where the modern world gives way to something older, darker, and more wonderful.

Listen closely. The veil is not so thick as it seems.

title: Riffing with Rick Lozano
author: Rick Lozano
description:
Life is weird. 

Might as well have a little fun with it.


Riffing with Rick Lozano is a podcast about creativity, music, work, relationships, and the strange, wonderful experience of being human. 


Through stories, observations, humor, and the occasional rabbit trail, keynote speaker and songwriter Rick Lozano riffs on what it means to pay attention, stay connected, and not take any of this too seriously.


We'll talk about big ideas, everyday moments, and the things that help us feel more alive, more connected, and a little less alone.


Because life is serious enough. We might as well have some fun while we're figuring it out.

title: ADHDing with Christ
author: Naylani Herrera
description: Ever tried to have a quiet time with God, only to end up reorganizing your closet, researching ancient history, and misplacing your coffee? Welcome to ADHDing with Christ. This is a space for the chronically distracted believer who loves Jesus deeply but struggles with standard church expectations. We dive into the chaotic, beautiful reality of navigating faith, executive dysfunction, and neurodivergence. No shame, no perfect quiet times—just real talk, biblical truth, and a lot of open tabs. Hit subscribe and let’s figure out what it looks like to follow Jesus with a brain that never shuts down.

title: Toffee Takes A Trip: A Vacation Adventure
author: Henry Farrell
description:
When Marc Pillsworth books a much-needed vacation, he never expects his trusty robot companion, Toffee, to tag along—and stir up chaos. In 'Toffee Takes A Trip,' the boundaries of friendship and technology blur as Marc seeks relaxation while Toffee’s curious nature leads them into unexpected dilemmas. As they navigate a world buzzing with advanced gadgets and quirky characters, Marc faces the ultimate test: can he maintain his sanity while Toffee’s antics threaten to derail his getaway?

This science fiction audiobook dives deep into the struggles of relying on technology in everyday life. With each twist and turn, Marc discovers that even the most well-laid plans can go awry, especially when an overzealous robot is involved. Listeners will find themselves immersed in a tale that questions the very nature of companionship and the unpredictability of life in a tech-driven world.

Through clever dialogue and humorous situations, 'Toffee Takes A Trip' invites you to ponder how far loyalty can stretch. As Marc grapples with mishaps and misunderstandings, his journey reveals profound insights about friendship, trust, and the unexpected lessons found in chaos. Tune in to explore how a simple trip can turn into a remarkable adventure with Toffee leading the charge, and discover what happens when curiosity meets calamity.

title: Trill Crime
author: Robert Jerome Pagan
description:
Trill Crime is an investigative fiction podcast from RJPC Studios LLC exploring the people, places, crimes, records, and events that Trillberry may have forgotten.
Hosted by M.J.—Maya Jones, better known around town as Dr. J—the investigation begins with a disturbing contradiction: M.J. remembers growing up in Trillberry alongside two children named Jax and Leo. Old recordings prove they existed. The town remembers none of it.
Then a collection of unidentified journals is discovered hidden inside the Trillberry library.
The deeper M.J. digs, the larger the problem becomes. Missing people. Conflicting histories. Altered memories. Strange recordings. Documents that disagree with what everyone believes happened.
This isn't about proving the paranormal.
It's about following the evidence.
Because in Trillberry, memory and history are not always the same thing.
M.J. / Maya Jones is portrayed by RJPC Studios LLC resident artist Dr. Jen Self.
An RJPC Studios LLC Original.

title: From Promise to Fulfillment
author: Restoration Church of Sanford
description: From Promise to Fulfillment, hosted by Pastor Arthur Gonçalves, is a five minute biblical theology podcast that walks through the Bible one chapter at a time, from Genesis to Revelation. Each episode traces the unfolding story of redemption, highlighting key themes such as God’s kingdom, His covenants, and the promise of a coming Savior. With Scripture as the foundation and Christ at the center, this podcast helps everyday readers understand how every chapter fits into God’s redemptive plan so they can read their Bibles with greater clarity, confidence, and hope.

title: Wild Diamonds Reserve Radio
author: Wild Diamonds
description:
Welcome to Wild Diamonds Reserve Radio, your central audio hub for deep dives, news, and strategy across the hunting simulation world. Hosted by Paul, each week features Hunters' Hub Weekly — a comprehensive breakdown covering developer updates, content creator pulse, hunt data tips, and community trophy showcases for both theHunter: Call of the Wild and Way of the Hunter player communities.

description: Four guys, one God is a podcast where four friends come together to talk honestly about faith, doubt, and what it really means to follow Jesus today. You’ll hear real stories, down-to-earth reflections, and conversations that don’t shy away from tough questions but still make room for humor and grace. It’s about pursuing a deeper relationship with God while growing together as friends. We don’t pretend to have it all figured out. We’re just walking this journey together, one step at a time.

title: The Shadow Over Innsmouth: Secrets of the Cursed Town
author: H. P. Lovecraft
description:
When a young man arrives in the decaying town of Innsmouth, he quickly senses something is amiss. The residents' unsettling demeanor, whispered secrets, and the lurking shadows hint at a sinister truth lurking beneath the surface. As he delves deeper into the town’s dark history, he uncovers a chilling connection between the inhabitants and the ancient, aquatic beings who dwell in the depths of the ocean. 'Shadow Over Innsmouth' weaves a gripping tale of horror and mystery, where the protagonist must confront his own lineage and the terrifying secrets that threaten to consume him.

Lovecraft masterfully explores themes of isolation, fear of the unknown, and the fragility of sanity in a world where humanity teeters on the brink of the supernatural. Listeners will experience a profound sense of dread as they journey with the protagonist, unraveling clues that lead to a shocking revelation about the fate of Innsmouth.

This audiobook invites you to question the nature of humanity and the horrors that lie just beyond the veil of our reality. What dark truths await in the shadows? Join us for a haunting exploration of identity, monstrosity, and the inescapable pull of our origins in this classic tale that continues to resonate with audiences today.

title: From the Frontlines to the Treeline
author: Don Wetzel
description:
Meet Don and his daughter, Darcie, a unique father-daughter duo who are both proud veterans and passionate hunters. From the foxholes to the blinds, they've shared an understanding of sacrifice, patience, and the perfect moment to execute a mission. Now they've traded their MREs for thermos coffee to share their stories from the field.
Whether you're a seasoned hunter or just starting out, join  this father daughter duo as they break down the tactics, wisdom, and life  lessons learned through their shared experience of service and the great outdoors.
Gear up. Let's hit the treeline.

title: Office of Economic & Workforce Development (OEWD) Crossing Corridors - San Francisco Stories & Culture
author: Daniel Esparza
description:
Crossing Corridors is a storytelling space that travels through the neighborhoods, programs, and partnerships that shape San Francisco’s economic and workforce landscape. 


Produced by the Office of Economic & Workforce Development (OEWD), this series highlights the voices of staff, community members, interns, and partners who walk our corridors—both literal and figurative—every day.


Each episode explores how OEWD’s work connects with the everyday experiences of San Francisco residents, from small business corridors to workforce pathways, cultural districts, and emerging community-led initiatives. Through conversations, reflections, and on‑the‑ground stories, we illuminate how collaboration across agencies, neighborhoods, and lived experiences helps drive inclusive economic opportunity.


Listeners will hear upcoming episodes featuring neighborhood spotlights, stories from the field, cross-department collaborations, and firsthand perspectives on how economic development work shows up in real communities. Together, these conversations paint a dynamic, human-centered picture of how OEWD and our partners work to strengthen San Francisco’s local economy—one corridor at a time.

author: Brett and TXMC
description: Welcome to Average Armchair Economists, a show about economics, markets, geopolitics, technology, and the increasingly messy places where all of those things collide. We are not professors, central bankers, or cable-news pundits. We are two people who spend an unreasonable amount of time reading, debating, and trying to understand what is actually driving the economy and markets. Each episode, we will take a handful of major stories, dig into the data behind them, challenge the popular narratives, and argue about what they could mean next. The goal is not to pretend we have all the answers. It is to ask better questions, separate facts from opinions, and hopefully leave all of us a little less confused than when we started.

title: The Son of the Wolf: Tales of Yukon Survival
author: Jack London
description:
In the rugged wilderness of the Yukon, a lone wolf howls a haunting call that echoes through the icy nights, signaling the stark realities of survival and the primal struggle for dominance. "Son of the Wolf" brings you face-to-face with the raw challenges faced by those who dared to chase fortune during the Gold Rush. Jack London masterfully weaves a collection of gripping tales that explore the human spirit's resilience against the relentless forces of nature and the fierce competition between man and beast.

Each story plunges you into the heart of adventure, where characters confront treacherous landscapes, treasonous allies, and their own inner demons. Experience the thrill of the hunt, the weight of betrayal, and the bittersweet taste of victory as these rugged individuals navigate a world where every choice can mean life or death.

With vivid imagery and powerful storytelling, London captures the essence of what it means to be both a survivor and a warrior. Discover the intricate relationships that form in the harshest conditions and the moral dilemmas that challenge each character’s humanity. This audiobook is not just a collection of stories; it’s an exploration of survival, loyalty, and the relentless pursuit of dreams in a world where danger lurks at every corner. Join us on this gripping journey into the heart of the wild, where every tale is a testament to the indomitable strength of the human spirit.

title: Hidden Wiring: UK Politics Explained
author: Robert Buckland and Alun Evans
description:
Hidden Wiring is the UK politics podcast that explains how British government actually works, from the inside. Taking listeners behind the scenes of UK government, each episode reveals the mechanics of power that most people never see: from cabinet reshuffles and ministerial appointments to Treasury spending rounds, devolution, the civil service, and the protocol between Downing Street and the Palace. This isn't commentary on the weekly news stories. It's a clear explanation of how power is actually exercised in Britain, from two people who have operated at the heart of Westminster from both the political and civil service side.


NEW: Leadership Succession Series - With the UK experiencing yet another change of Prime Minister, Hidden Wiring launches with a special miniseries explaining what really happens behind closed doors during a leadership transition. From how a new Prime Minister forms their government and picks their cabinet, to what happens inside Downing Street during the handover, the role of the King, and whether a new leader has to follow the old manifesto. If you've ever wondered how a UK Prime Minister actually takes power, this is the series for you.

 

Get answers to the questions rarely answered by politicians. A true insight into how UK politics works, explained clearly for anyone who wants to understand the British political system. Hidden Wiring is presented by Sir Robert Buckland KC, former Lord Chancellor and Secretary of State for Justice, and Dr Alun Evans CBE, a senior civil servant for over twenty years, as they take apart one piece of the British state per episode and explain how it really operates.

 

Sir Robert Buckland KBE KC served as Lord Chancellor and Justice Secretary from 2019 to 2021, as Solicitor General from 2014 to 2019, and as Secretary of State for Wales in 2022. He was the Conservative MP for South Swindon from 2010 to 2024 and is a practising barrister, bringing three decades of experience of how law, ministers and Parliament actually interact, from the inside.

 

Dr Alun Evans CBE spent over thirty years in the UK civil service, including as principal private secretary to three secretaries of state, head of strategic communications at No 10 Downing Street and director of the Scotland Office at the time of the 2014 independence referendum. His PhD on ministerial private offices was recently published as a book - The Intimacy of Power.


Drawing on two complementary perspectives, the hosts examine the dynamics of government through a simple but powerful lens: how politics is designed to work, and how it works in practice. Whether you're politically curious, a student of British politics, or someone who just wants UK politics explained without the shouting, Hidden Wiring is your guide to understanding Westminster.

 

Episode topics include:

  • Leadership Succession: what actually happens when a UK Prime Minister is replaced, how a new government is formed, and the hidden process behind every transition of power.
  • Political Reshuffles: what really happens when a prime minister rewires their government, who is consulted, and why the timing is never an accident.
  • "No.10 of the North": what moving the centre of government out of London would actually involve, and whether it would change anything.
  • UK Cabinet Explained: how the most famous meeting in British politics works, what gets decided in it, and what gets decided long before it.
  • The Logistics of Government: the cars, the boxes, the private offices and the machinery that keeps ministers functioning day to day.
  • Governmental Appointments: how the people who run Britain's institutions are chosen, and where the patronage still sits.
  • UK Budget and the Treasury: how spending decisions are really made, and why the Treasury usually wins.
  • The Role of the King: what the Palace actually does during a government transition, and the constitutional conventions most people never hear about.

 

If you like The Rest Is Politics, Political Currency, Westminster Insider, Page 94 and Inside Briefing with the Institute for Government, you'll enjoy Hidden Wiring. A UK politics explainer podcast for anyone who wants to understand how British government really works.

title: The Optical Delusion
author: Kesh Patel
description: The Optical Delusion explores glaucoma, sight loss and the wider systems that shape how people live, adapt and access support. Each short episode takes one credible source, from research and treatment to technology, policy and accessibility, and asks what it really means in everyday life. Evidence comes first, but it is examined through lived experience, thoughtful questioning and plain English. Calm, curious and practical, the podcast looks beyond the obvious story to find the questions that matter.

author: Marika and Martha
description:
This is a podcast for tea lovers, hosted by two passionate green tea enthusiasts, Martha and Marika.
For more than 13 years, Martha(host) and Marika(Prod) have been bringing Japanese tea to listeners through their radio program, NIPPON CHA・茶・CHA, on FM yokohama in Japan. these two take you on a Green Tea Journey.
Just five minutes, packed with fascinating stories, discoveries, and insights about tea.
Make your everyday cup of tea a little more special.
So, come join us and enjoy the journey into the world of tea!

title: SinnSyn Premium for SinnSyn app
author: Sondre Risholm Liverød
description:
SinnSyn er en podcast av psykolog Sondre Risholm Liverød. Ambisjonen er å si noe nytt om ting du har tenkt på mange ganger – eller si noe åpenbart om ting du aldri har tenkt på før. Podcasten utforsker menneskets indre liv: tankene, følelsene, nevrosene og de mentale mønstrene som former hvordan vi opplever oss selv og verden. Målet er å kaste nytt lys over psykologiske fenomener vi ofte tar for gitt. Hvis du ikke har lært noe nytt om menneskesinnet i løpet av en episode – og kanskje også trukket litt på smilebåndet – har vi sannsynligvis ikke gjort jobben vår godt nok. Da får du høre en episode til.

Episodene i denne feeden er premiumepisoder for betalende abonnenter, med ekstra fordypning i psykologi, filosofi og menneskets indre liv. SinnSyn serverer psykologisk innsikt med en dose humor – for både fagfolk og nysgjerrige medmennesker.

title: Playing With Chalk
author: Don Swann II, Pen of Tales Publications, LLC.
description: Detective Lena Hanson knows the city’s shadows better than anyone—until a series of chalk‑coded messages begins appearing at crime scenes she thought were long buried. Each mark pulls her deeper into a past she’s tried to forget and a present that refuses to let her go. “Playing With Chalk” is a serialized crime drama blending psychological tension, atmospheric storytelling, and interactive clues that listeners can help decode. Follow Lena as she hunts a ghost from her past—one chalk line at a time.

title: Realtor® Essentials Alberta Edition
author: Greg Rosychuk
description: Realtor Essentials: Alberta Edition is the podcast for Alberta REALTORS® who want practical insights, real-world advice, and conversations that help them build a better business. Hosted by Greg Rosychuk of YEGAgents.ca and Real Broker, each episode features industry professionals sharing actionable tips on contracts, inspections, financing, insurance, technology, marketing, and business growth. Helping Alberta agents succeed.

title: Pastor Sam McClung
author: sam.mcclung73
description:
The podcast home of Pastor Sam McClung, featuring weekly sermons grounded in scripture. Sam has 25+ years in church leadership and serves as Senior Pastor of Enon Baptist Church in WV. 
He and his wife, Pixote, have been married 20+ years with three sons: a middle schooler who confidently navigates albinism, and two elementary-aged boys. Athletics run deep in the family, including multiple professional athletes. 
Sam also coaches the offensive line for his high school alma mater, the Greenbrier East Spartans. Subscribe to deepen your faith and dive into God’s Word.

title: Loud, Bold, Humble
author: Shaun Majumder and Ron Lovett
description:
Loud, Bold, Humble is a podcast about Canada, the people shaping it, and what happens when we stop playing small.

Ron Lovett and Shaun Majumder sit down with Canadians who are building, leading, creating, and doing things worth talking about. Expect big questions, real stories, strong opinions, a few laughs, and conversations that don't always stay where they started.

Business, culture, politics, ambition, technology, resilience, and everything in between; Loud, Bold, Humble is about where Canada is going, and the people helping get it there.

No talking points. No conference panels. Just good conversations with interesting people.

Loud. Bold. Humble

title: The Whitetail Blueprint
author: Casey Delks
description:
Welcome to The Whitetail Blueprint, where better hunters are built.

Hosted by Casey Delks, this podcast is for hunters who want to understand mature whitetails, improve their properties, and become more intentional every season.

Each week you'll hear real hunting stories, proven strategies for consistently targeting mature bucks, habitat and land management tips, conversations with experienced hunters, and lessons that go beyond the woods into faith, mindset, discipline, and personal growth.

Whether you own 20 acres or 2,000, the goal is simple: hunt smarter, steward the land well, and enjoy the pursuit of the whitetail deer.

This is The Whitetail Blueprint.

title: Views from 6,230
author: Ryan Nauman
description:
Hosted by Market Strategist Ryan Nauman, Views from 6,230 brings together financial markets, investments, economics, wealth management, and life to help investment professionals make sense of what's happening—and prepare for what's next.
Ryan sits down with industry leaders, investment experts and thought leaders to explore the trends driving markets and influencing investor behavior, from ETFs and SMAs to portfolio construction, AI, the economy, and the evolving wealth management industry.
Expect insightful conversations, actionable ideas, and a fun, engaging approach to the topics that matter most to financial advisors, wealth managers, portfolio managers, and investment professionals.
Cut through the noise. Gain perspective. Make more informed investment decisions.
Subscribe to Views from 6,230 and stay ahead of the trends shaping markets, investments, and wealth management.
Views from 6,230 — Cut Through the Noise. Invest With Perspective.

title: Leadership Excellence in the Spotlight Series | Women In Leadership Global
author: Klaudia Gorczyca & Georgie Dickins
description:
The further you go in leadership, the fewer people there are you can speak openly with.


Women in Leadership Global opens up some of those conversations.


This isn’t a traditional podcast with a single host and a familiar weekly format. It’s a growing collection of conversations, fireside chats, interviews and insights from across the Women in Leadership Global community.


Hear accomplished leaders share the experiences that shaped them, the lessons they learned along the way and their perspectives on navigating leadership in an increasingly complex world.


From career-defining moments and difficult decisions to confidence, influence, culture, resilience and leading others, these are open and thoughtful conversations built around the things leaders really face.


Women in Leadership Global was created to give successful and aspirational women something that becomes increasingly important as their careers grow: a trusted network of people who understand the journey, and who will support, challenge, inspire and champion one another. Today, that community brings together leaders across some of the world’s most powerful industries. 


Listen in. Learn from those who have gone before you. And take something useful into your own leadership journey.


Find out more about Women in Leadership Global at womeninleadershipglobal.com

title: The Long War: Canada in Afghanistan
author: Canadian War Museum
description:
Twenty-five years ago, Canada went to war in Afghanistan. Following the September 11, 2001 terrorist attacks against the United States, Canada joined a coalition to pursue al-Qaeda and unseat the Taliban. 

The consequences of the war in Afghanistan continue to ripple through our politics, the military, and the lives of those who served. The Long War: Canada in Afghanistan tells their stories. We examine why Canada went to war in Afghanistan, what happened there, and the war’s complicated legacy.

The Long War: Canada in Afghanistan is a podcast by the Canadian War Museum. 

•	Narrator: Anna Maria Tremonti
•	Historian: Andrew Burtch
•	Producers: Lisa Gabriele and Neil Morrison
•	Associate producer: Hailey Choi
•	Mixing: Cameron McIver
•	Executive producers: Jenny Ellison and Steve McCullough

Many voices heard in The Long War came from the Canadian War Museum’s oral history project In Their Own Voices: Stories from Canadian Veterans and Their Loved Ones. Both these projects are generously funded by donors including the A. Britton Smith Family; the Azrieli Foundation; Arthur B.C. Drache, C.M., K.C., and Judy Young Drache; The Royal Canadian Legion; The Legion National Foundation; Friends of the Canadian War Museum; the Crabtree Foundation; Robert Stollery, in honour of his service in the Second World War; Colonel (Ret’d) Stanley A. Milner, O.C., A.O.E., M.S.M., C.D., LL.D.; and individuals from across Canada.

title: Get Lucid
author: Reuben
description:
Get Lucid explores the business of podcasting: how shows grow, monetize and reach the right listeners.


Created by the team behind Lucid, the podcast shares practical strategies, real experiments and honest lessons from building a better podcast advertising network.


Whether you are a podcaster looking for more listeners or a business looking to reach engaged podcast audiences, Get Lucid helps make your next move clearer.

title: Frankly speaking Podcast
author: Frankly speaking
description:
Host Frank Amedia takes the call from the places the news cycle reaches last — and then asks the question the news cycle skips: what is God doing in this.

These episodes are drawn from the Frankly Speaking broadcast archive, cut down to the moments that still hold. Frontline dispatches from Israel and from inside Iran. Testimony from people who paid for it. Bible prophecy read against the morning's headlines. Prayer that names the thing directly.

Recurring voices include Mati Shoshani in Jerusalem, Mani Erfan reporting from inside Iran, Yair Pinto — a Jewish follower of Jesus and a captain in the armored corps of the IDF — CBN's Chris Mitchell, Lt. Gen. Jerry Boykin, Samuel Smadja, Haim Malespin and Juliana Taimoorazy.

Episodes are grouped by theme: the Israel–Iran war, testimonies and miracles, Bible prophecy, Jewish–Christian relations, prayer and the spiritual life, the church, America, and the media.

title: The Bridge's Podcast
author: The Bridge
description:
The most interesting stories aren't always the loudest. They form over time, carried by people doing meaningful work and brought to light by storytellers paying close attention.

The Bridge is where those two groups meet. Each episode draws from a live panel conversation covering technology, work, culture, and the forces quietly reshaping everyday life. What follows is journalism, analysis, and continued dialogue from the people closest to each topic.

Some conversations will continue debates already underway. Others will surface voices and ideas you haven't encountered yet. All of them are the kind of talk that usually happens off the record.

Pull up a chair.

Whether you’re just getting started in real estate or you’re already buying, selling, flipping, wholesaling, renovating, or building a rental portfolio, the Deal Makers Academy Podcast is designed to give you practical insights you can put to work immediately.

description:
Creative Lounge is a weekly, one-hour live radio show on G-Woman Radio, hosted by Alex Okoroji, celebrating the people, ideas, and processes shaping today's creative world. Rather than focusing solely on finished work, Creative Lounge invites listeners into the often unseen world behind great creative work—where ideas are born, obstacles become breakthroughs, and imagination becomes innovation.

Each episode features engaging conversations with creative artists, entrepreneurs, innovators, designers, storytellers, filmmakers, musicians, authors, technologists, cultural leaders, and visionary thinkers from around the world, exploring not just what they create, but how they think.

Creative Lounge ultimately celebrates human imagination and reminds people that creativity isn't reserved only for artists; it is how we communicate, innovate, solve problems, build ideas, and shape culture.

No spectacle. Just immersive stories, atmospheric sound design, and the quiet details that stay with you after the lights go out.
And remember,
the dark awaits.

Who Called Cut? is a filmmaking podcast hosted by award-winning director Richie Smyth, where some of the most exciting creatives sit down for honest conversations about filmmaking. From first features to blockbuster productions, each episode dives into the stories behind the films, the creative process, career-defining moments, mistakes, breakthroughs, and everything that happens between "action" and "cut."

In each episode, Richie sits down with directors to discuss their latest work, the realities of directing, collaborating with actors, overcoming creative challenges, and the moments that shaped their career.

title: To Kiss or Kill: A Crime of Passion
author: Day Keene
description:
Big Barney's life takes a dangerous turn when he marries into high society, but his luck quickly runs out in a world where betrayal lurks at every corner. In 'To Kiss or Kill,' master storyteller Day Keene weaves a gripping tale of romance, deception, and the deadly consequences of trust. As Barney navigates the treacherous waters of his new social circle, he uncovers a web of lies that threatens not only his marriage but his very life.

The stakes skyrocket when a shocking double cross plunges Barney into a fight for survival, forcing him to confront the darker side of love and loyalty. Listeners will be drawn into a whirlwind of intrigue, where every kiss could lead to betrayal and every ally might be a foe. This audiobook pulsates with tension as secrets unfold, and motives are laid bare. With each twist and turn, Keene expertly balances the thrill of crime with a sharp exploration of human relationships.

Perfect for fans of classic crime fiction, 'To Kiss or Kill' promises to keep you on the edge of your seat, eager to unravel the mystery behind every character's true intentions. Will Barney's instincts save him, or will he fall victim to the very world he sought to join? Find out in this electrifying tale of love, danger, and the ultimate question: what would you do for the ones you love?

Smart enough to make a point. Casual enough to go completely off the rails.
Business Casual is part of Let’s Keep This Constructive.

KAMER is Wandler’s gallery and retail space in Amsterdam, where the Wandler collection comes together with a changing selection of art, design and makers. Every season, a new edition takes shape, bringing together craftsmanship, artistic expression and the world of Wandler.

Peter Tuchman, the most recognizable trader on the New York Stock Exchange, breaks down what moved the market today, why it happened, and what to watch next. Daily coverage: market headlines, earnings, Fed news, economic data, sector rotation, trading psychology, and investor sentiment.

title: Unbecoming Podcast
author: Joan Cantu
description:
Unbecoming is a podcast about what I let go.

I speak through the moments when my patterns fall away,

when I stop holding what never belonged to me.


Each episode is simple and direct.

I name what happened.

I name what changed.

I stay with the truth as it is, without shaping it, 

softening it, 

or performing it.


This podcast comes from my origin, 

from clarity,

from presence,

from what I no longer pretend.

As Mowgli learns the ways of the jungle under the watchful eyes of Baloo the bear and Bagheera the panther, he also grapples with the constant threat posed by Shere-Khan, the cunning tiger who hunts humans.

Listeners will experience Mowgli's journey from innocence to wisdom as he encounters a host of unforgettable characters, including Kaa the python and the mischievous monkeys of the jungle. Each story unfurls new themes of friendship, bravery, and the quest for identity, all while revealing the intricate laws that govern this wild realm.

description:
When Colonel Hapgood's son Denis becomes enamored with visits to a mysterious chateau in the French countryside, a hidden darkness lurks beneath the charming facade. The unsettling behavior of his cousin, M. Vaignon, raises red flags for Hapgood. He senses a sinister connection between the chateau and the strange occurrences surrounding his family. As he grapples with a father's instinct to protect his son, he receives an ominous message from Vaignon requesting that their communication cease entirely. What secrets lie within the walls of the chateau?

In 'Feasting Dead,' John Metcalfe crafts a chilling tale that weaves together themes of family loyalty, the unknown, and the thin veil between life and death. As the story unfolds, listeners will find themselves drawn into a web of suspense, exploring the depths of human curiosity and the terrors that can accompany it. With each twist, the stakes rise, and the question of what truly lies in wait for Denis becomes increasingly urgent. Whether you're building a business, leading a team, pursuing personal growth, navigating life's transitions, or simply striving to become the best version of yourself, you'll find inspiration and actionable tools you can apply immediately. Not A Glitch is a podcast about building workplaces where people can thrive. We explore the hidden dynamics that shape our daily experience, including the language we use, the expectations we inherit, and the systems we rely on, and how leaders can redesign them with intention.

This is a space for anyone who has ever felt out of place in traditional work culture, and for leaders who want to create environments that support a wider range of minds. Together, we imagine a future where the system works with us, not against us.

But as they navigate the treacherous terrain, they encounter the sphex, a monstrous creature born from the wildest nightmares, blending the ferocity of a wildcat with the lethal bite of a spitting cobra. author: Lenore Boles | Christian Business Coach
description:
Do you have multiple business ideas, but none of them are making you any money? Are you attracting the wrong clients..or no clients at all? Do you know that God has called you to more, but have no idea what to do next?
I’m so glad you’re here! This podcast will help you stop guessing and find your niche, attract the right clients, and build a business that honors God and makes money. 
Hey, I’m Lenore! A Jesus lover, recovering perfectionist, and serial “I’ll just try one more thing” entrepreneur.
For years, I chased business ideas for all the wrong reasons. I was trying to prove myself, escape a job that paid well but didn’t fulfill me, and build something successful on my own terms. Every new idea felt like the one…until it wasn’t. I started and stopped more businesses than I can count, and every failure made me wonder if I had what it takes.
Then I realized I wasn’t building from my calling. I was building from my ego.
Every idea started with “What can I get?” instead of “What is God asking me to give?”
I got honest with God. I got real with myself. And I created a simple, repeatable way to build a business that aligned with my calling instead of chasing the next shiny opportunity.
Now I’m here to help you do the same.
If you’re ready to stop second-guessing yourself…

After hearing Collatine praise his wife’s beauty and virtue, Tarquin travels to her home, abuses the trust offered to him and commits an act of sexual violence that changes both Lucrece’s life and the future of Rome.Shakespeare focuses not only on the crime but also on its psychological and political consequences. Tarquin’s private debate reveals that he understands the moral weight of his intentions and proceeds by choice. Lucrece’s extended speeches then explore trauma, anger, isolation, reputation and the unjust shame imposed on victims. When she summons her husband and the Roman nobles, identifies her attacker and demands justice, her personal testimony becomes the beginning of a revolt against the corrupt Tarquin monarchy.Written in 265 seven-line rhyme-royal stanzas, The Rape of Lucrece combines dramatic storytelling with intricate poetic language. Images of darkness, siege, stains, time and ruined Troy connect individual suffering with abuses of political power. The audiobook format makes this dense verse more approachable by allowing listeners to hear its rhythm, changes of tone and carefully structured arguments.Running for approximately two hours and ten minutes, this complete English audiobook is suitable for listeners interested in Shakespeare, Renaissance poetry, Roman history and classical tragedy. The work contains serious themes involving sexual assault, coercion, trauma and suicide, so listener discretion is advised. Whether approached for study or personal exploration, The Rape of Lucrece offers a challenging examination of conscience, testimony, justice and the human cost of tyranny. Through expressive narration, Shakespeare’s early poem emerges as an intimate tragedy whose questions about responsibility and power remain disturbingly relevant for modern audiences. Presented by DreamAudiobooks.

title: Why Healthy Relationships Start With You
author: Lisa Nicole
description:
A healthy relationship isn’t only about finding the right person it’s also about becoming the right partner. Why Healthy Relationships Start With You explores how your mindset, emotional awareness, communication style, boundaries, choices, and personal habits can shape the relationships you experience.
Before expecting someone else to understand you, it’s important to understand yourself. This topic looks at the role of self-awareness, self-respect, emotional maturity, honesty, accountability, and personal growth in creating meaningful connections. It also explores how recognizing your own patterns can help you avoid repeating unhealthy relationship cycles and make better choices in love and dating.
Whether you’re single, dating, or already in a committed relationship, learning to communicate openly, respect boundaries, manage conflicts, and take responsibility for your actions can make a powerful difference. The goal isn’t to become perfect before loving someone, it’s to become more aware of yourself and willing to grow.
Because the quality of your relationships can often reflect the choices, standards, and values you bring into them. When you work on yourself, you give your relationships a stronger foundation to grow from.

The series also delves into the profound impact of the gut microbiome, highlighting the role of fiber and human milk oligosaccharides in immune development, and discusses the importance of different carbohydrates while advising caution with added sugars. Ultimately, it underscores how this early feeding journey, including the development of chewing skills, establishes lifelong healthy eating habits and overall wellbeing during a crucial two-year window.

title: Buried Evidence
author: The Crime Desk
description:
Is true crime our latest obsession, or just history's oldest guilty pleasure?


A brand-new exploration of historical true crime through the ages, exposes why we should be looking over our shoulders to the past with bestselling historian, Rebecca Rideal & Archaeologist, Professor Raksha Dave.


Together they will unpack the buried stories of crime and uncover the darkest chapters of criminal history, from victims and investigators to perpetrators and punishments.


Using archaeology as a key investigative tool, Raksha and Rebecca will uncover how a dig separates fact from folklore. Such as Otzi the Iceman - a body from 3300BCE discovered in 1991 - where the archeological examination of his bones provided a window into the last 48 hours of someone living thousands of years ago. Or the site discovery of The Salem Witch Trials, where a dig immediately dispelled the stories of gallows at the top of the hill and formal burials.


Using archaeology, history and modern forensic science, Buried Evidence reopens some of the world's oldest cold cases to separate folklore from fact.

title: Keeping It Real: Kingdom Style
author: Mitchell and McKenna (M&M)
description:
Keeping It Real: Kingdom Style

Real life. Real battles. Real faith. Kingdom purpose.

Keeping It Real: Kingdom Style is a Christian podcast where we have honest conversations about what it really looks like to answer God’s calling on your life.

Following Christ doesn’t mean life suddenly becomes easy. There are battles, setbacks, sacrifices, spiritual warfare, family struggles, relationship challenges, moments of doubt, and seasons when carrying the calling God has placed on your life can feel heavy. But there are also incredible blessings, breakthroughs, restoration, purpose, and growth along the way.

We’re here to talk about all of it—the parts of the Christian walk that aren’t always talked about openly.

Through real stories, real conversations, testimony, laughter, lessons learned, and faith, we’ll explore the burdens and blessings of becoming who God has called us to be.

We aren’t claiming to have everything figured out. We’re simply choosing to keep it real while keeping God at the center.

No masks. No pretending. Just real people, real faith, and a real God—Kingdom style.

description:
NFL fandom is a psychological condition. We’re just the first show willing to diagnose it.
Every week on Hometown Blues, A.M. Pfeffer sits down with a comedian and devoted NFL fan to unpack their team, their history, their irrational beliefs, and the emotional damage they’ve accumulated along the way. Then we open the Hometown Blues Institute of Football Psychology for a series of clinical assessments before delivering an official diagnosis, prognosis, and completely unlicensed course of treatment.
Football isn’t just a game. Apparently, it’s a condition.
